canonical_drive_contract.valid_when: the closure Jacobian has a regular one-dimensional nullspace
canonical_drive_contract.fallback: reduce step size, change chart, or stop/branch at a singular point
canonical_drive_contract.interpretation: The solver moves the whole closed mechanism along its one-dimensional branch. Neither U coordinate is independently prescribed.

source_fiber_drive_contract.commanded_coordinate: the scalar slice value c is fixed for the entire fiber
source_fiber_drive_contract.valid_when: the combined source constraint has rank n-1 and nullity one
source_fiber_drive_contract.fallback: choose another regular slice chart or mark the fiber critical/unresolved
source_fiber_drive_contract.interpretation: The task slice selects which one-dimensional fiber is being solved. It does not independently drive alpha and beta.
